ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $BD$ bisects $\angle ABC$. If $AB=8$, $BC=12$, and the area of $\triangle ABD$ is $16$, then what is the area of $\triangle CBD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, draw $DE\perp AB$ at E, and $DF\perp BC$ at F, \\
$\because BD$ bisects $\angle ABC$, $DE\perp AB$, $DF\perp BC$, \\
$\therefore DE=DF$, \\
$\because {S}_{\triangle ABD}=\frac{1}{2}AB\times DE=16$, \\
$\therefore DE=4$, \\
$\therefore DF=4$, \\
$\because BC=12$, \\
$\therefore {S}_{\triangle BCD}=\frac{1}{2}\times BC\times DF=\frac{1}{2}\times 12\times 4=\boxed{24}$.
